patch_list: Allow Screenshots & Screen Security Bypass - Signal (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Bypasses Android FLAG_SECURE window restrictions in Signal, allowing users to take screenshots and record screens even when Screen Security is enforced.
AMOLED Dark Theme & Hide Donation Nags - Signal (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Injects pure OLED pitch black (#000000) into Signal chat threads and settings, and suppresses donor badges and 'Support Signal' donation reminders.
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Prevents sending outgoing typing indicators and suppresses read receipt delivery confirmations for enhanced conversation privacy.
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Activates the client-side Signal Sustainer / Supporter profile badge and unlocks exclusive supporter avatar rings and custom app icons.
